title: Pre-hello firmware (no hello at all)

setup.describe: Flash a FIXTURE build with `fixture-no-hello`: the board neither sends the unsolicited hello nor answers the client's Hello request, which is exactly what pre-hello firmware looks like. Both halves are suppressed on purpose — Studio's client ASKS as well as listening, so answering would make the board compatible again.

manual: The card should land Incompatible (no-hello) — absence of a hello IS the mismatch signal (docs/adr/2026-07-14-wire-hello-versioning.md).
AFTER capturing: put the board back with the card's Update/Flash, or `just build-fw-esp32c6` + espflash.
